snippet.title: Cutout Village – New Trailer: Demo Now Available on Steam
snippet.description:
The demo of Cutout Village is now available on Steam! Enjoy the first few minutes of this charming city-builder and crafting game, and add it to your wishlist. Coming soon to PC and consoles.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3907910/Cutout_Village/
